g.text: HVR34 keeps the full actual ground-state Hessian contraction in the second energy moment.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #496472

g.text: The plots illustrate the exact inequalities at R=4 and the moment extremizer ν=δ₂ (E=2, E₂=4).

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #496472

g.text: They are algebraic examples, not Yang–Mills vacuum data. All actual finite-volume factors and limits remain in HVR1–HVR34.
